lootbeams.custom_config.desc: Configuration for custom equipment identification and rarity conditions.
lootbeams.custom_config.equipmentRegiste: Register custom equipment items, tags, or Mod IDs.
Set of item IDs to be considered as equipment.
Set of item tags (starting with '#') to be considered as equipment.
Set of Mod IDs whose items will all be considered as equipment.
Set of item IDs excluded from being considered as equipment.
lootbeams.custom_config.rareCondition.de: Conditions for determining if an item is rare.
lootbeams.custom_config.rareCondition.ra: Minimum rarity ordinal value required for an item to be treated as rare.
lootbeams.dynamic_config.desc: Settings for dynamic pulsing effects of beams and glow.
Toggles whether beams and glow effects have dynamic pulsing animations.
lootbeams.dynamic_config.half_round_tick: Duration in ticks for half of a dynamic pulse cycle.
lootbeams.light_config.desc: Render settings for loot beams, bottom glow, and custom colors.
lootbeams.light_config.beam.desc: Appearance and display conditions for loot beams.
Toggles rendering of item loot beams.
lootbeams.light_config.beam.beam_fade_in: Time in ticks for the beam to fade in after spawning.
Distance at which the loot beam starts rendering.
Base height of the loot beam.
lootbeams.light_config.beam.static_beam_: Keeps the beam height fixed without pulsing up/down or growing out of the ground.
lootbeams.light_config.beam.beam_y_offse: Vertical offset of the loot beam.
lootbeams.light_config.beam.beam_alpha.d: Transparency of the beam (0.0 for completely transparent, 1.0 for solid).
lootbeams.light_config.beam.common_short: Renders a shorter beam for common rarity items.
lootbeams.light_config.beam.solid_beam.d: Renders the beam with a solid, opaque style.
lootbeams.light_config.beam.require_on_g: Only renders the loot beam when the item rests on the ground.
lootbeams.light_config.beam.allow_use_na: Use Item Name Color as Beam Color
Uses the item's custom name color as the beam color when no specific color is configured.
lootbeams.lightconfig.beam.allow_use_nam: when no color provided by internal providers and config, mod will use the name color as the beam color
lootbeams.light_config.glow.desc: Settings for the circular glow effect on the ground below items.
Toggles rendering of ground glow under dropped items.
lootbeams.light_config.glow.glow_effect_: Radius of the ground glow effect.
lootbeams.light_config.customColorSettin: Customize beam colors for specific items, tags, or Mod IDs.
Map of item IDs to custom beam colors.
Map of item tags to custom beam colors.
Map of Mod IDs to custom beam colors.
lootbeams.light_config.lightEffectFilter: Light Effect Filter
Filter which items display light beams and glow effects.
All Items
Displays light beams for all dropped items.
Only Rare Items
Displays light beams only for rare or higher items.
Only Equipment
Displays light beams only for equipment items.
Whitelist by Item ID
Item IDs that will always display light beams.
Whitelist by Tag
the format is the same as the datapack format, start with "#".
the format is the same as the datapack format, start with "#".
lootbeams.light_config.lightEffectFilter: Whitelist by Mod ID
Mod IDs whose items will always display light beams.
Blacklist by Item ID
Item IDs that are prohibited from displaying light beams.
Blacklist by Tag
the format is the same as the datapack format, start with "#".
Blacklist by Mod ID
Mod IDs whose items are prohibited from displaying light beams.
lootbeams.loot_information_config.desc: Settings for item name tags, rarity labels, and tooltip overlays.
lootbeams.loot_information_config.lootIn: Controls how dropped item information is displayed.
Choose the display format for dropped item information.
Displays information tags for all dropped items.
lootbeams.loot_information_config.rarity: Control which item rarities display rarity text.
Choose item rarity threshold for displaying rarity tags.
lootbeams.loot_information_config.nameTa: Appearance and parameters of 3D name tags rendered above items.
Displays the name tag only when the player looks at the item.
Adds a black outline to the name tag text.
Displays stack quantity (e.g. x64) after the item name.
Sensitivity angle threshold for detecting player look.
Opacity of the name tag text.
Opacity of the name tag background box.
Scale size multiplier for the name tag.
Vertical position offset for the name tag.
lootbeams.loot_information_config.toolti: Position and keypress controls for item tooltip overlays.
Renders the tooltip overlay only while sneaking (crouching).
Alignment style for the screen tooltip overlay.
Horizontal offset in pixels for custom tooltip placement.
Vertical offset in pixels for custom tooltip placement.
lootbeams.sound_config.desc: Settings for drop sound effects and sound filters.
lootbeams.sound_config.sound.desc: Toggle and volume adjustment for item drop sounds.
lootbeams.sound_config.sound.enable_soun: Plays custom sound effect when item drops.
lootbeams.sound_config.sound.sound_volum: Playback volume level for item drop sounds.
lootbeams.sound_config.soundFilter.desc: Filter which items will not play drop sound effects.
lootbeams.sound_config.soundFilter.black: Item IDs that are prohibited from playing drop sounds.
Item tags prohibited from playing drop sounds.
Mod IDs whose items are prohibited from playing drop sounds.

Controls enabling and strategies for Photon particle FX.
Applies Photon particle FX to all item loot beams.
Configures which particle elements are replaced.
Default Photon particle effect ID to use.
Strategy for combining Photon particle FX with default beams.
Map of item IDs to specific Photon particle effect IDs.
lootbeams.photon_compat_config.fxControl: Color override and replacement options for particle groups.
Configures color replacement for specific particle group names.
